title: Something wearing Maureen

greeting.text: The bell. A quilted vest. A paper plate under cling wrap. You heard on the radio what became of her van.
Oh, thank goodness, a light on. I'm Maureen. I baked these this morning and I've nobody left to give them to. Go on, love.
The same words. All of them, in the same order. Whatever is on the plate is the right shape for a scone.

annoyed: Now, I don't mind a careful young person.

notes.wrist: Both wrists, held out together. Look at one. Now look at the other.
notes.reflection: A grey bun, keeping time. They have learned that one.
notes.shadow: The tubes are overhead. Look which way she falls.

topics.ask: You said all this last night.
topics.answer: Did I? I say it very well, don't I. {echo|Listen:} ...there. That one was yours.

topics.ask: Maureen is dead. Take her off.
topics.answer: She was kind to you. I thought you'd like to see her again.

wren.arrive: Oh. Oh, they've done her nicely.
wren.adviceLine: Be gentle with it, Sam. It came all this way to bring you something. Let it have its coffee.

after.break: You could have let it finish the scone.
after.serve: See how easy that was? Nobody had to be anybody.

serve.text: You're a good one, Sam. Whoever made you did a proper job.

turnAway.text: No. But I remember her being fond of you. That has to count for something.

shelter.text: Is that where the others are? Lovely.

break.text: You turned her out, and now you want her back. You can't have it both ways, love.
It folds the cling wrap, neatly, and goes.

report.serve: A woman bought fuel at Corrigan's overnight using a missing traveller's card. Her family asks us to say: she has already been found. That is not her.
report.turnAway: A figure in a quilted vest was seen standing in the run-off lane below Corrigan's, beside an empty campervan, holding a plate.
report.shelter: Corrigan's reports one guest sheltering. The guest's daughter says her mother's body was identified on Tuesday.
report.break: A paper plate was found on the centre line. Rangers have asked that nobody eat what is on it.
report.missed: A woman waited at Corrigan's door for some hours overnight. Witnesses say she did not once shift her weight.
